title: Facet dictionary (coordinate-dictionary/0)
description: A profile's published dictionary for coordinate/0: its families, each with its rule for how many of its facets a coordinate may hold, and its facets, each with a distinct prime. The dictionary id is sha256 of the RFC 8785 canonical form. Rules the schema cannot express (names, ids and primes distinct and sorted, every facet in a declared family, primality, and the order in which the checks run) are in spec/coordinate-0.md.

profile.description: The id of the profile that publishes the dictionary, such as kernel/2.

families.description: Sorted by name in code point order, names distinct.

values.description: one: at most one facet of the family, with exponent 1. set: distinct facets, each with exponent 1. multiset: any facets, repeated any number of times.

facets.description: Sorted by ascending prime, ids and primes distinct.

id.description: <family>.<name>, where <family> is the name of a family in families.

prime.description: A prime below 2^31. Must also be prime (checked outside the schema).
